description: Read-only XRPL trust-line lookup for one account. `account` is the required XRPL classic account address; use `peer` to restrict results to one counterparty, `limit` to cap returned trust lines, `marker` to continue pagination from a previous response, and `ledger_index` to pin the lookup to a validated ledger. The result lists trust-line state including issued-asset balances and limits without modifying the ledger, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits. Use this for an account's trust lines and issued-asset holdings; use n9t2_xrpl_get_account_info for current account state or n9t2_xrpl_list_account_objects for other ledger objects.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose trust lines should be listed.
account.title: Account

ledger_index.description: Optional validated ledger index or selector.
ledger_index.title: Ledger Index

limit.description: Optional maximum number of trust lines to return.
limit.title: Limit

marker.description: Pagination marker returned by a previous response.
marker.title: Marker

peer.description: Optional XRPL classic account address used to filter trust lines to a specific peer.
peer.title: Peer

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_lines
